title: SciRerankBench: Benchmarking Rerankers Towards Scientific Retrieval-Augmented Generation with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2508.08742v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific literature question answering is a pivotal step towards new scientific discoveries. Recently, \textit{two-stage} retrieval-augmented generated large language models (RAG-LLMs) have shown impressive advancements in this domain. Such a two-stage framework, especially the second stage (reranker), is particularly essential in the scientific domain, where subtle differences in terminology may have a greatly negative impact on the final factual-oriented or knowledge-intensive answers. Despite this significant progress, the potential and limitations of these works remain unexplored. In this work, we present a Scientific Rerank-oriented RAG Benchmark (SciRerankBench), for evaluating rerankers within RAG-LLMs systems, spanning five scientific subjects. To rigorously assess the reranker performance in terms of noise resilience, relevance disambiguation, and factual consistency, we develop three types of question-context-answer

translated_title: SciRerankBench：面向大语言模型科学检索增强生成的重排序器基准测试
translated_abstract: 科学文献问答是迈向新科学发现的关键一步。近来，两阶段检索增强生成大语言模型（RAG-LLMs）在这一领域展现出了令人瞩目的进展。这种两阶段框架，尤其是第二阶段（重排序器），在科学领域中尤为重要，因为术语上的细微差异可能会对最终的面向事实或知识密集型的答案产生极大的负面影响。尽管取得了这一重大进展，这些工作的潜力与局限仍有待探索。在本工作中，我们提出了一个面向科学重排序的RAG基准（SciRerankBench），用于评估RAG-LLMs系统中的重排序器，涵盖五个科学学科。为了严格评估重排序器在噪声鲁棒性、相关性消歧和事实一致性方面的性能，我们开发了三种类型的问题-上下文-答案...
tldr: 该论文提出了SciRerankBench，一个用于评估大语言模型科学RAG系统中重排序器的基准，覆盖五个科学学科，并从噪声鲁棒性、相关性消歧和事实一致性三个维度系统评估重排序器的性能与局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SciRerankBench, a benchmark for evaluating rerankers within LLM-based scientific RAG systems across five scientific subjects, rigorously assessing their noise resilience, relevance disambiguation, and factual consistency.
